description.en:
Loads a 2D image and returns its handle; "<LG>" in the file name is replaced by the game's language code. The image is added to the event's object list. Wait with WaitLoading, show it with CMND_SET_ENABLE, place it with CMND_SET_POSRY([x, y]) and delete it with CMND_DELETE_IMAGE.
The third argument is the kind: 0 (default) a still image (.xi), 1 an animated image (.xa). The fourth argument is read twice: as a string it is the animation to start with (kind 1); as a number, 1 selects a second setting (not traced; the scripts pass 1 for the "next" arrow).

Handle of the image.
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: A still picture (real code, from ie4_ev_main.nut, PlayTrailer)
